definition: to live somewhere for a short time
description: A grand hotel lobby with a black and white chequered marble floor, gold columns and a starburst chandelier. At first a golden retriever in a maroon uniform vest is seen up close, its front paws on the marble reception desk next to a set of keys, and a hand picks up the keys. Then the whole lobby shows: the dog stands on its hind legs at the desk, a laughing young woman in a cream suit points at it, and a young man in a navy shirt lifts a suitcase near a brass luggage trolley. Guests sit behind them.

taps.target: the woman in the cream suit
